items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the projection formula and the compatibility of pushforward with composition for a classical Weil cohomology theory (statement lines 1603-1608). The proof (proof lines 1609-1624) pairs both assertions with an arbitrary class, uses the compatibility of pullback with the degree map, and concludes by nondegeneracy of the pairing. H2: a complete short computation whose two displayed substitutions are checkable by the reader.
